text: The pipeline begins by taking a limited set containing a varied number of input face images of an individual across different poses and expressions.
These images are fed into the Omni-ID Encoder, which integrates the image set features using cross-attention and self-attention mechanisms.
The encoder outputs Omni-ID, a fixed-size structured representation that consolidates holistic identity information across views.
During training, this representation conditions a bank of multiple decoders, combining complementary objectives such as masked reconstruction and flow matching.
Through this few-to-many reconstruction task, decoders generate numerous target face images covering diverse poses and expressions while preserving identity.
The input images are sampled directly from the broader target identity set, closing the loop on the few-to-many training strategy.
